subject: Re: Saturday lane shift — inbound pallets & customs paperwork
messages:
From: Timothy Lee <tim.lee@atlasdrayage.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@summitworks.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Carrier lane change for booking 5229 (Redwood)

Hi Mina —

Quick heads up: our original drayage partner had an equipment issue and BlueLine Logistics has accepted a same-day lane for your booking 5229. ETA to SummitWorks dock is now Sat 12/12, 10:00–14:00. Pro number is BL-5229-RED.

Can you please send the finalized BOL and commercial invoice so the new carrier can complete customs checks? Also confirm the on-site contact name and a phone number for Saturday.

I attached the provisional carrier confirmation image in case you need to share it with the venue. If customs needs additional paperwork (COO, HS codes), let me know ASAP — we can hold at port but want to avoid late fees.

Thanks,
Timothy Lee
Operations, Atlas Drayage
(t) 415-555-0168

Attachment: carrier_confirmation.jpg (image stub)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Timothy Lee <tim.lee@atlasdrayage.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@summitworks.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Carrier lane change for booking 5229 (Redwood)

Tim — thanks for the quick update. Saturday window is tight for our crew. A few quick asks: 

- Please attach the BOL + commercial invoice to this thread so we can forward to venue customs.
- Confirm whether BlueLine will handle ISF/CBP handoffs or if Atlas is handing the customs clearance. 
- On-site contact will be Vanessa Ortiz (cell 650-555-2210); can you confirm carrier will call Vanessa 30–45 min prior to arrival?

Sean/Marissa — I’ve looped you for ops and courier pickup adjustments. If Saturday is confirmed, Marissa we’ll need the pre-pickup shift to 6am on Sat so the driver hits the dock slot.

Sophie — if SummitWorks needs a physical copy of documents at the gate, please confirm and we’ll print and courier over.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Mina Haddad
Field Marketing Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Carrier lane change for booking 5229 (Redwood)

Got it — we’ll pivot. Operational notes: 

- Marissa, please update the pickup manifest and move the courier pickup to 06:00 on Sat. Driver: Atlas pickup #A-783.
- Vanessa, I’ll send the on-site team brief with pallet counts and crate IDs; expect a call from BlueLine once they stage.
- I’ve generated the ASN for SummitWorks and uploaded it to our drive (link below). The ASN includes item-level descriptions so venue customs can cross-check quickly.

If the carrier cannot confirm a 30–45 min ETA call, we should escalate to Atlas and request an on-site rep. Saturday dock schedules fill up fast; keep Sophie in the loop for gate access.

Sean Gallagher
Field Ops (Events)
Redwood Inference

Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExhibitShipments_Redwood (ASN_exhibit_manifest.pdf)

From: Timothy Lee <tim.lee@atlasdrayage.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@summitworks.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Carrier lane change for booking 5229 (Redwood)

Mina/Sean — attaching BOL_5229.pdf and the customs invoice. Atlas will coordinate the ISF clearance; BlueLine will perform the physical drayage. BlueLine confirmed they will call Vanessa 30–45 min prior to arrival and will present electronic docs at gate.

We recommend SummitWorks have a customs rep available at the dock for quicker release; otherwise there may be a 45–90 minute processing delay.

Attachments: BOL_5229.pdf, Commercial_Invoice_5229.pdf

Timothy Lee
Atlas Drayage

Attachment stubs: BOL_5229.pdf, Commercial_Invoice_5229.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@summitworks.com>, Timothy Lee <tim.lee@atlasdrayage.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Dec 2026 17:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Final confirmation — Saturday 12/12 dock 10:00–14:00 (BL-5229-RED)

Sophie/Tim — thank you — confirmed: BlueLine will arrive Sat 12/12 between 10:00–14:00 with pro BL-5229-RED. Vanessa will be the on-site contact (650-555-2210) and will meet the truck at Gate 4. 

Marissa: please dispatch the driver for a 06:00 pickup and include two hard copies of the BOL in the courier bag. 

Sean: if SummitWorks reports any customs hold, escalate to Tim and cc me. If we hit a >90 minute hold, we will request an on-site Atlas rep and assess using the alternate carrier (Local Xpress) queued as backup.

Thanks everyone — fingers crossed for a smooth unload. I’ll post a short status update in Slack when pallets are signed at dock.

Mina Haddad
Field Marketing Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ASN_exhibit_manifest.pdf (uploaded to Drive), carrier_confirmation.jpg (from Atlas)
